crypto.label: Crypto
crypto.description: Hashing, encryption, keys, and password tools.

converter.label: Converter
converter.description: Convert between data formats, encodings, and units.

web.label: Web
web.description: URL, HTTP, JWT, and browser-related utilities.

media.label: Images & Videos
media.description: QR codes, SVG placeholders, and camera recording.

dev.label: Development
dev.description: Git, Docker, JSON, SQL, regex, and dev cheatsheets.

network.label: Network
network.description: IP, subnet, MAC, and IPv6 utilities.

data.label: Data
data.description: Phone numbers, IBAN, VIN, SSN, credit cards, ISBN, SWIFT/BIC, and barcodes.

security.label: Security & Privacy
security.description: PII redaction, security headers, breach checks, CSP analysis, and certificate decoding.

cipher.label: Classical Ciphers
cipher.description: Historical and educational cipher tools - Caesar, Vigenère, Atbash, Morse, and more.

devops.label: DevOps & Infrastructure
devops.description: Nginx, systemd, Kubernetes, DNS, Dockerfile, cron, and port-forwarding utilities.

api.label: API & Testing
api.description: HTTP request building, API development, mock utilities, and schema validation.

i18n.label: Internationalization
i18n.description: ICU MessageFormat, locale formatting, plural rules, language/currency/country codes, and Unicode utilities.

finance.label: Finance & Calculators
finance.description: Loan, compound interest, currency, VAT, income tax, invoice, ROI, depreciation, and break-even calculators.

geo.label: Geographic & Coordinates
geo.description: Coordinate conversion, geohash, Plus Code, distance, timezone, bounding box, and what3words utilities.

a11y.label: Accessibility
a11y.description: Color contrast, ARIA labels, alt text, tab order, WCAG reference, heading structure, focus indicators, and screen reader text.

av.label: Audio & Video
av.description: Audio and video conversion, transcoding, trimming, merging, and metadata utilities.
